entries.summary: Initial build: SW, manifest, OneSignal v16, install prompts, nonce endpoint, admin settings
entries.notes: Plugin skeleton, SW written to ABSPATH, manifest to ABSPATH, OneSignal v16 merged SW, Android/iOS install sheets, nonce refresh endpoint at /oha/v1/nonce, admin settings page

entries.summary: Offline map strategy: MapTiler tile caching, Ohio overview tile pre-cache, stale-while-revalidate for map data and listing pages
entries.notes: SW intercepts api.maptiler.com (cache-first), /oha/v1/map/ REST endpoint (stale-while-revalidate), /places/ + /events/ pages (stale-while-revalidate). Ohio tiles z6-8 pre-fetched at SW install via OHIO_TILES injected by write_sw() using the MapTiler key from oha_map_maptiler option. Persistent caches: oha-tiles-v1, oha-map-data-v1.

entries.summary: write_sw() now injects OHIO_TILES_JSON placeholder; on_settings_saved() rebuilds SW as well as manifest
entries.notes: on_settings_saved() now calls write_sw() in addition to write_manifest() so offline URL and tile list stay current when admin settings change.

entries.summary: Added body classes is-oha-member and is-board, inline head pwa-mode detection, offline class toggling in JS
entries.notes: PHP body_class filter adds is-oha-member (oha_member_id meta) and is-board (manage_options or edit_posts). Inline wp_head script adds pwa-mode class before CSS paints. oha-pwa-init.js toggles pwa-offline on online/offline events.

entries.summary: Added CSS visibility utility classes: pwa-show/hide, member-show/hide, oha-member-show/hide, board-show/hide, offline-show/hide
entries.notes: Classes target html.pwa-mode, body.logged-in (WP native), body.is-oha-member, body.is-board. Use via Kadence/Gutenberg Additional CSS class(es) on any block.

entries.summary: Login reliability layer: uwp_login_redirect + login_redirect filters, 30-day sessions, JS redirect_to injection
entries.notes: class-oha-site-pwa-login.php: uwp_login_redirect filter overrides bad redirects (wp-admin, login page itself); login_redirect backup for direct wp-login.php access; auth_cookie_expiration extends to oha_spwa_session_days (default 30 days); JS injects redirect_to=current-URL into UWP modal form submits at capture phase - fixes PWA standalone mode where HTTP_REFERER is not sent so wp_get_referer() returns empty; oha_pwa_s cookie + sessionStorage used to detect new login and send CLEAR_PAGE_CACHE to SW.

entries.summary: SW handles CLEAR_PAGE_CACHE message to drop page cache when user logs in
entries.notes: Added CLEAR_PAGE_CACHE branch in SW message handler. Sent by login JS when oha_pwa_s cookie user ID differs from sessionStorage value - indicates a fresh login this session.

entries.summary: Added Login section to admin settings: member redirect URL, owner redirect URL, session length
entries.notes: Options: oha_spwa_member_redirect, oha_spwa_owner_redirect, oha_spwa_session_days. Used by role_redirect() in login class to decide where non-admin users land after login.

entries.summary: Add autocomplete attributes to UWP login form via JS for browser credential save and biometric autofill
entries.notes: UWP AUI input renderer does not emit autocomplete attributes. Without autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, Chrome and Safari cannot offer to save credentials or trigger Face ID / Touch ID. Fix: fixLoginAutocomplete() runs at DOMContentLoaded and via MutationObserver so it covers both inline forms and the lazily-loaded lightbox modal.

entries.summary: Notification permission prompt: slide-up banner with 30s delay, first-visit skip, defer/dismiss via localStorage
entries.notes: oha-pwa-notify.js: sets window.ohaSpwaPushReady callback (called by oha-pwa-init.js after OneSignal init). Checks Notification.permission, ohaPushSubscribed state, and first-visit flag before showing. Not Now defers 7 days; second Not Now dismisses permanently. Accept calls OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optIn(). Banner output via wp_footer in notify_banner_html(); JS only enqueued when push is configured (app ID + push_enabled both set).

entries.summary: Skip notification prompt on iOS Safari browser — web push requires standalone mode on iOS
entries.notes: Added iOS browser guard to canShow() in oha-pwa-notify.js. Without this, the banner appeared on iOS Safari browser and tapping Enable did nothing (iOS only supports web push for installed standalone PWAs). Fix: check /iP(hone|ad|od)/ userAgent + display-mode:standalone; if iOS and not standalone, return false and never show the prompt.

entries.summary: Floating pill bottom nav bar: Haunts, Events, Home (center elevated), Map, My OHA
entries.notes: 5-tab floating pill nav (position:fixed, border-radius:28px, overflow:visible for center pop-up). Center Home button elevated 14px with red rounded-square badge. Only visible in html.pwa-mode (standalone). Active tab highlighted in palette1 red via oha-pwa-nav.js path matching. Nav HTML output via nav_html() hooked to wp_footer with inline SVG icons. Added oha_spwa_nav_map_url WP option; settings Navigation Tabs section updated to match tab order. Body padding-bottom set for content clearance including safe-area-inset-bottom.

entries.summary: PWA app header bar: hides Kadence header in standalone mode, shows site logo + hamburger
entries.notes: html.pwa-mode class toggled in head; body padding-top offset includes safe-area-inset-top

entries.summary: Slide-out navigation drawer tied to Appearances > Menus PWA Navigation location
entries.notes: register_nav_menus adds pwa_navigation location; wp_nav_menu outputs it in drawer panel; drawer open/close via oha-pwa-nav.js

entries.summary: Micro-interaction animations: icon pop on tab tap, drawer slide with cubic-bezier, center button press state
entries.notes: oha-icon-pop keyframe; oha-nav-tapped class added/removed on click via JS; center badge scale(0.92) on :active

entries.summary: Add [oha_spwa_settings] shortcode: app info, restore prompts, check for updates, reset data
entries.notes: New file: includes/class-oha-site-pwa-shortcodes.php. Registered in oha-site-pwa.php boot. Place shortcode on a WP page and link it from the PWA drawer nav. All actions are localStorage-only, no AJAX.

entries.summary: Suppress site PWA header, pill nav, and notify banner on convention PWA pages
entries.notes: Added is_convention_page() helper to class-oha-site-pwa-service-worker.php. Reads oha_convention_base_url option, falls back to /convention/. All three wp_footer hooks return early when on convention pages.

entries.summary: Fix Kadence site header not hiding in standalone PWA mode
entries.notes: Added .site-header to the html.pwa-mode hide rule in oha-pwa.css alongside #masthead. Kadence outputs both the ID and class; the ID alone was not matching on this installation.

entries.summary: Added CSS custom properties --oha-spwa-header-height and --oha-spwa-nav-clearance on html.pwa-mode
entries.notes: Exposes header and nav clearance heights as CSS vars so other plugins (e.g. oha-modern-map) can read live values without hardcoded magic numbers. Values include safe-area insets.

entries.summary: Admin backend send form in Settings > OHA Site PWA for sending push notifications
entries.notes: Separate form below settings with title/message/URL fields; shows recipient count on success; manage_options only

entries.summary: REST endpoint POST /oha/v1/push/send for board member push sends from PWA frontend
entries.notes: edit_posts capability check; used by PWA send form via X-WP-Nonce header; params sanitized via register_rest_route args

entries.summary: Board-gated send notification form added to [oha_spwa_settings] shortcode output
entries.notes: Only rendered if current_user_can edit_posts; uses REST endpoint with wp_rest nonce inlined by PHP; clears fields on success

entries.summary: Publish meta box on posts and pages for send-on-publish or send-now notifications
entries.notes: Draft: checkbox fires on publish via save_post, records _oha_spwa_push_sent. Published: Send Now AJAX button. Works with classic and block editors.

entries.summary: Subscriber count display in push settings section pulled from OneSignal app API
entries.notes: 5-minute transient cache; shows messageable_players (opted-in) and total players; red error if API call fails

entries.summary: Fixed OneSignal serviceWorkerPath using relative path causing 0 subscriber registrations on all non-root pages
entries.notes: Changed oha-site-sw.js to /oha-site-sw.js in oha-pwa-init.js; relative path resolved to wrong URL on pages below root
